canonicalizer: rfc8785@0.1.4 (Python) / canonicalize@2.0.0 (TypeScript) / stdlib SHA-256 + direct JCS construction (Go, Ruby, Rust, C#/.NET, Java, Kotlin)

anchored_to.preimage_key_order: JCS RFC 8785 lexicographic: chain_seq, issuer_id, prev_receipt_hash, receipt_hash
anchored_to.link_condition: chain_seq > 0 AND prev_receipt_hash = receipt_hash of the immediately preceding receipt
anchored_to.spec_authorship: AlgoVoi-authored; specified in IETF Internet-Draft draft-hopley-x402-retention-chain-00 (16 June 2026)

derivation: Three consecutive chain records for issuer_id 'algovoi:test'. receipt_hash values are SHA-256 of the UTF-8 encoding of the literal string shown in receipt_preimage. Vector 0 is the genesis record (chain_seq=0, prev_receipt_hash empty). Vectors 1 and 2 are subsequent chain links, each referencing the receipt_hash of the immediately preceding record. Each retention_chain_ref is SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical bytes of the four-field preimage.

context.purpose: Pin the three canonical retention_chain_ref values for the genesis and first two chain links of an algovoi:test issuer sequence. Any implementation claiming to implement the Retention Chain Substrate algorithm MUST reproduce these values verbatim for the given preimage inputs.
verification_recipe: 1. Compute receipt_hash_N = 'sha256:' + SHA-256(UTF-8(receipt_preimage_N)) for each vector.
2. Construct preimage object with the four fields in the order shown.
3. Canonicalise the preimage using RFC 8785 JCS. Verify expected_jcs_bytes_b64 matches.
4. Compute SHA-256 of the canonical bytes. Prefix with 'sha256:'. MUST equal expected_chain_ref.
5. Verify chain linkage: vector N's prev_receipt_hash MUST equal vector N-1's receipt_hash.

chain_invariants.link_1: Vector 1: prev_receipt_hash MUST equal vector 0's receipt_hash
chain_invariants.link_2: Vector 2: prev_receipt_hash MUST equal vector 1's receipt_hash

vectors.description: Chain link. chain_seq=1, prev_receipt_hash = vector 0's receipt_hash.
Chain link. chain_seq=2, prev_receipt_hash = vector 1's receipt_hash.
